basic_details.job_title: MERC Independent Member Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission has invited applications for the post of Independent Member for Consumer Grievance Redressal Forums in the State of Maharashtra under Section 42(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003. Eligible candidates must send their applications by post to reach The Secretary, Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission, 13th Floor, Centre-1, World Trade Centre, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai 400 005 on or before 25/11/2026 by 05.00 pm.

qualification.details: Independent Member of the Forum shall hold office for a fixed term of three (3) years as per Regulation 4.5 of MERC (Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum & Electricity Ombudsman) Regulation 2020. The tenure of Independent Member may be extended by the Commission for a further period not exceeding two (2) years subject to an overall age limit of sixty-five (65) years. | Monthly remuneration is Rs. 35,000/- per month. Statutory Taxes will be deducted at source. Remuneration is inclusive of allowance such as sitting fees, honorarium and all other allowance such as conveyance allowance, telephone charges etc. For holding the additional charge of Chairperson or Independent Member of other CGRF, 25% additional remuneration and the TA/DA at the rate as applicable to the Chief Engineer or equivalent shall be applicable.

selection_process: selection process may be on basis of interview to be conducted by Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission. Prescribed qualifications are minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitle the candidate for selection. Canvassing in any form will disqualify candidature. The Commission shall verify the integrity and background of the applicants. The Commission may select the candidate for one of the locations specified by the applicant or any other vacant position
based on the discussion during the interview/appointment process.
important_instructions: Applicant shall provide up to five preferred locations to work as a Independent Member. Canvassing in any form will disqualify candidature. If any false/incorrect information furnished by the candidate is detected at any stage of recruitment process, his/her candidature will not be considered. If the candidate knowingly or wilfully furnishes incorrect or false particulars or suppresses material information, he/she will be disqualified and if appointed, shall be liable for dismissal without any notice or assigning any reasons whatsoever. The decision of the MERC in all matters relating to recruitment shall be final and no individual correspondence will be entertained. No separate applications to be sent, if applicant is applying for the post of Independent Member at more than one location. Incomplete applications and/or applications received after the due date shall not be considered for evaluation. Applications submitted through any other mode shall not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: MERC Independent Member at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: At least 10 years of experience in consumer grievances

content_sections.heading: About MERC Independent Member
content_sections.text: The Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission administers the appointment of Independent Members for Consumer Grievance Redressal Forums in accordance with the Electricity Act, 2003, and the MERC (Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum & Ombudsman) Regulations, 2020 and MERC (Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum & Electricity Ombudsman) (First Amendment) Regulations, 2024. These appointments are made for distribution licensee MSEDCL across specified circles in Maharashtra to address consumer grievances.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent by post to the following address: The Secretary, Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission, 13th Floor, Centre-1, World Trade Centre, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai 400 005 Candidates must mention the post applied for on the envelope as Application for the post of Independent Member, CGRF . content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Independent Member of the Forum shall hold office for a fixed term of three (3) years as per Regulation 4.5 of MERC (Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum & Electricity Ombudsman) Regulation 2020. The tenure of Independent Member may be extended by the Commission for a further period not exceeding two (2) years subject to an overall age limit of sixty-five (65) years. Monthly remuneration is Rs. 35,000/- per month. Statutory Taxes will be deducted at source. Remuneration is inclusive of allowance such as sitting fees, honorarium and all other allowance such as conveyance allowance, telephone charges etc. For holding the additional charge of Chairperson or Independent Member of other CGRF, 25% additional remuneration and the TA/DA at the rate as applicable to the Chief Engineer or equivalent shall be applicable.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Personal profile / application form as per format Attested copies of certificates in support of Qualification, Experience, Age etc. Recommendation from registered Voluntary Consumer Protection Organisation with whom applicant is working

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: If necessary, selection process may be on basis of interview to be conducted by Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission. Prescribed qualifications are minimum and mere possession of the same does not entitle the candidate for selection. Canvassing in any form will disqualify candidature. The Commission shall verify the integrity and background of the applicants. The Commission may select the candidate for one of the locations specified by the applicant or any other vacant position, based on the discussion during the interview/appointment process.

The decision of the MERC in all matters relating to recruitment shall be final and no individual correspondence will be entertained. faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for MERC Independent Member recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Independent Member posts under Amravati Circle and Wardha Circle.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application is 25/11/2026 by 05.00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly remuneration for the Independent Member?
faq.answer: The proposed remuneration is Rs. 35,000/- per month, which is inclusive of allowance such as sitting fees, honorarium and all other allowance such as conveyance allowance, telephone charges etc.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required work experience for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have experience of working for at least ten (10) years on matters concerning consumer Grievances.

faq.question: Q5. What is the tenure of appointment for an Independent Member?
faq.answer: Independent Members hold office for a fixed term of three (3) years, which may be extended by the Commission for a further period not exceeding two (2) years subject to an overall age limit of sixty-five (65) years.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent by post along with personal profile, attested copies of certificates, and recommendation from a registered Voluntary Consumer Protection Organisation to the Secretary of MERC in Mumbai.

faq.question: Q7. Can an applicant apply for more than one location?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants can provide up to five preferred locations to work as an Independent Member, and no separate applications to be sent, if applicant is applying for the post of Independent Member at more than one location.
